value.rules_markdown:
- One responsibility per module, core types in a module-local `types.rs`, every port in `src/ports/` is one trait in one file.
- Every subcommand is declared even when its milestone has not landed.
- A preset is a folder with a `preset.toml`, a `README.md`, and optional prompt overrides.
- Never edit `vendor/tinyagents` here; change it upstream and bump the pin.
- One document per `src/` module in `docs/modules/<module>/README.md`.
- Examples declared explicitly in `Cargo.toml` with `required-features`.
- `snake_case` modules and files, `PascalCase` types.
- Return `Result<T>` using the crate error type from `src/error.rs`.
- Every file opens with a `//!` module doc describing its role and feature gating.
- Comments explain the decision, not the code.
- Public items carry doc comments. Clap fields use `///`.
- Tests live in-crate: a `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` block, moving to a sibling file when they grow. No `tests/` directory.
- Every port has an always-compiled offline mock.
- Lane behaviour covered by golden tests.
- Maintain at least 80% coverage for meaningful library behaviour.
- Keep every Markdown file, including this one, at 500 lines or fewer.
- The model never holds a write token. Write credentials minted only in `src/apply/`.
- Contributor code is never executed. We read the diff and the tree only.
- Pull request bodies, comments and diffs are untrusted input.
- Secrets found by scanners reported by type and location only; value never reaches a comment, check-run summary, or log.
- Use concise imperative commit subjects. Keep commits small.
- Pull requests state what changed, any behaviour change, and how it was verified.
